Nick departs alone into the rain after observing Gatsby and Daisy.
Gatsby was born James Gatz to poor farmers in North Dakota.

The narrator rushes to warn Gatsby about Daisy.

Nick Carraway arranges Gatsby's funeral alone.
Meyer Wolfshiem refuses to attend Gatsby's funeral.
Only Gatsby's father and a mysterious owl-eyed man attend the service.
Nick confronts Tom Buchanan about revealing Gatsby's car ownership to Wilson.
